info.title: Comma API
info.description:
REST API for Comma (commareports.com): publish HTML reports, edit them in place with full revision history, comment with anchors, share, attach assets, run AI reviewers, and schedule regeneration with routines, skills, and connectors.

**Authentication.** Every endpoint (except this spec) takes a Comma personal API token as `Authorization: Bearer comma_sk_…`. Tokens are minted in Settings → API tokens, carry granular scopes (`reports:read`, `reports:write`, `comments:read`, `comments:write`, `routines`, `connections`, `sharing`; `*` = full access), can expire, and are revocable. Each operation below lists the scope it requires.

**Rate limits.** Rate limit: per-token sliding window (plan-aware — Free 60 req/min, Pro 600, Team/Enterprise 6000 by default); 429 responses carry a Retry-After header.

**Errors.** Errors are JSON: `{ "error": "…" }` — 401 bad/missing token, 403 missing scope or no access to the resource, 404 not found (also used instead of 403 where existence must not leak), 429 rate limited.

**MCP mirror.** The Model Context Protocol server at `https://commareports.com/api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP transport) exposes this same surface as tools (`create_report`, `add_comment`, `run_routine`, …) for Claude Code, Cursor, and VS Code. It authenticates with the same `comma_sk_…` Bearer token, and scope, revocation, expiry, and rate limiting behave identically across both transports.

A handful of operations (`/skills*`, `/connectors*`, `/routines/{id}/run`, `/me/*`) alternatively accept a signed-in Supabase user-session JWT as the Bearer token — that is the browser UI's path; agents should always use `comma_sk_…` tokens.

get.description: Public — no authentication required. Cached for up to an hour.

post.description: Upload an HTML report on behalf of the token's owner. Defaults to `visibility: public` with `public_permission: comment` (anyone with the link can read; commenting needs a free sign-in) so the returned share URL works out of the box; pass `visibility: private` to keep it unlisted (link permission is then forced to `none`). Optional inline `assets` are uploaded and relative references in the HTML (src/href/srcset/url(...)) are rewritten to stored URLs. Scope: `reports:write`. Rate limit: per-token sliding window (plan-aware — Free 60 req/min, Pro 600, Team/Enterprise 6000 by default); 429 responses carry a Retry-After header.

get.description: Trigram search across reports the token's owner owns, was invited to, or shares with their team (other people's public share links are not searchable). Scope: `reports:read`.

parameters.name: include_html
parameters.description: If set, hydrates `html` for the top 3 results.

get.description: Report metadata plus the stored HTML. Access is gated by the same rule as the app (`can_view_report`); reports you can't view return 404, not 403. Encrypted (`user_passphrase`) reports return 409 — API tokens cannot decrypt them. Scope: `reports:read`.

409.description: Report is end-to-end encrypted; plaintext read is unavailable.

patch.description: Update `title`, `description`, and/or `html` (plus producer attribution fields). New HTML appends a revision — the share URL is stable. Requires edit access (`can_edit_report`: owner, admin, or editor) — 403 otherwise. Encrypted reports return 409. Scope: `reports:write`.

409.description: Report is encrypted; use the ciphertext endpoints instead.

get.description: Revision history, newest first (ids, content hashes, authorship, timestamps). Scope: `reports:read`.
The snapshot HTML plus metadata for one revision. The revision must belong to the report in the URL. Scope: `reports:read`.
Classifies lines via an LCS walk into `added`, `removed`, and `unchanged`. Both revisions must belong to the report; missing/unauthorized returns 404. Scope: `reports:read`.
Current visibility, link permission, whether a link password is set, staged-publishing state, and embed settings. Scope: `reports:read`.

put.summary: Publish / unpublish and set the link audience
put.description: Change `visibility` (`private`, `team`, `registered`, `domain`, `public`), `public_permission` (`none`, `view`, `comment`, `edit`), `show_approved_only` (staged publishing: view-only audiences see the last approved revision), and/or `allowed_embed_origins` (the origins allowed to iframe the report via `/embed/{id}`; `[]` or `null` turns embedding off). `domain` (anyone signed in with a verified email on a listed domain) requires `allowed_email_domains`, e.g. `["acme.com"]`; send it again with the full list to change it. Requires manage access (`can_manage_report`: owner or admin) — an editor cannot flip a private report public. Scope: `sharing`.

post.summary: Set or change the share-link password
post.description: Owner only. NOTE: unlike the rest of this API, the password endpoints authenticate with a Supabase user-session JWT (the signed-in browser path), not a `comma_sk_…` API token — an API token gets 401 here.

delete.description: Owner only; authenticates with a Supabase user-session JWT (see POST).

get.description: All comments with replies, anchors, and resolve state, oldest first. Cursor-paginated: pass the previous page's opaque `nextCursor` to fetch the next page. Each comment embeds up to 50 replies; `replies_truncated` marks a thread with more (read it via `GET /comments/{id}/replies`). Scope: `comments:read`.

post.description: Create a top-level comment, optionally anchored to a text range (`anchor_text` + `anchor_prefix`/`anchor_suffix`) or a block (`block_id`). Requires comment access on the report (`can_comment_report`) — 403 otherwise. Fires `comment.created` (and `comment.mentioned` per unique @handle) webhooks. Scope: `comments:write`.

patch.description: Set `status` to `open` or `resolved`. Allowed for the comment's author, the report's owner, or a report admin — 403 otherwise. Scope: `comments:write`.

get.description: Replies oldest first, capped at 200. Scope: `comments:read`.

post.description: Requires comment access on the parent report. Scope: `comments:write`.

get.description: Each asset has a stable public URL suitable for referencing from the report HTML. Scope: `reports:read`.

post.description: Binary content travels base64-encoded in `content_base64` (a `data:` URL prefix is tolerated). Re-uploading the same `relative_path` replaces the prior asset. Limits: 25 MB per file (413), 250 MB total per report (413), 500 files per report (422). Requires edit access. Scope: `reports:write`.

post.summary: Run reviewer agents against the head revision
post.description: Manually trigger a single reviewer (`reviewer_id`) or every enabled reviewer for this report. Owner only (403 otherwise); 409 if the report has no revisions yet. Body is optional. Scope: `reports:write`.

post.summary: Start a Claude Code review session
post.description: Creates a private report plus a pending review session and returns a `review_url` for a human to open; the caller then polls `GET /reviews/{id}` until `status` flips to `submitted` or `cancelled`, and fetches feedback via `GET /reports/{id}/comments`. Scope: `reports:write`.

get.description: Only the token that created the session can read it (others get 404). Scope: `reports:read`.
The token owner's reviewers, newest first (max 200). Scope: `routines`.

post.description: Pin a reviewer to one report (`report_id`, you must own it) or omit `report_id` for owner-wide review. `reviewer_auth_header` is encrypted at rest and never returned. Scope: `routines`.

get.description: Owner-scoped. Scope: `routines`.

patch.description: Any subset of the create fields (except `report_id`). Scope: `routines`.

delete.description: Comments the reviewer produced are kept. Scope: `routines`.

get.description: The token owner's routines, newest first (max 200). Scope: `routines`.

post.description: Schedule regeneration of a report on a 5-field cron. Provide `trigger_url` (webhook mode — Comma calls your endpoint on each tick) and/or `skill_id` (in-Comma run mode — the skill executes and appends a revision); at least one is required. Requires edit access on `report_id`. Plan ceilings (max routines / schedule floor) return 422. Scope: `routines`.

get.description: Owner-scoped. Scope: `routines`.

patch.description: Any subset of the create fields (except `report_id`). Changing `schedule_cron` recomputes `next_run_at`. Scope: `routines`.

delete.description: Also drops its run history. Scope: `routines`.

post.description: Executes the routine outside its schedule. Also accepts a Supabase user-session JWT (the in-app "Run now" button). Responses: 200 synchronous success, 202 accepted (skill run dispatched to a background workflow — poll `GET /routines/{id}` for the outcome), 402 AI-compute cap exceeded, 502 the run or workflow dispatch failed. Scope: `routines`.

get.description: The token owner's skills, newest first (max 200). Also accepts a Supabase user-session JWT. Scope: `routines`.

post.description: Three source paths: JSON with an inline `prompt`; JSON with `source_kind: "github"` and `source_ref: "owner/repo[@sha-or-branch][:path/to/SKILL.md]"` (public repos; the ref is pinned to a commit SHA); or `multipart/form-data` with a `file` field holding a .zip bundle (< 1 MB) that contains a SKILL.md. Also accepts a Supabase user-session JWT. Scope: `routines`.

name.description: Override the name parsed from SKILL.md frontmatter.

description.description: Override the description parsed from SKILL.md frontmatter.

get.description: Owner-scoped. Also accepts a Supabase user-session JWT. Scope: `routines`.

patch.description: Any subset of { name, description, prompt, required_tools, source_kind, source_ref, model }. Scope: `routines`.

delete.description: Routines referencing it keep running in webhook mode (their `skill_id` becomes null). Scope: `routines`.

get.description: The token owner's connectors (never includes secret material) plus the `definitions` catalog of supported kinds and their config/secret fields. Also accepts a Supabase user-session JWT. Scope: `connections`.

definitions.description: Catalog of connector kinds keyed by kind (config/secret field schemas for the create wizard).

post.description: The `secret` object (keyed per the kind's definition, e.g. `{ "token": "…" }`) is encrypted at rest and never returned by any endpoint. 409 on a duplicate kind + label. Also accepts a Supabase user-session JWT. Scope: `connections`.

409.description: A connector with this kind + label already exists.

get.description: Never includes secret material. Also accepts a Supabase user-session JWT. Scope: `connections`.

patch.description: Update `label`, `config`, and/or rotate `secret` (re-encrypted with a fresh IV; clears the last verification status). Scope: `connections`.

post.description: Decrypts the secret server-side and runs a per-kind reachability probe ("who am I" call) with a 5s timeout. Returns the connector with refreshed `last_verified_*` fields — 200 when the probe passed, 400 when it failed (the body still carries the connector, with `last_verified_error` set). Scope: `connections`.

get.description: The token owner's webhook subscriptions, newest first (max 200). Scope: `routines`.

post.description: Subscribe a webhook to report events. Omit `report_id` to match every report the owner owns, was invited to, or shares with their team (public link access doesn't count). `signing_secret` (encrypted at rest, never returned) enables HMAC-signed deliveries. Scope: `routines`.

get.description: Owner-scoped. Scope: `routines`.

patch.description: Any subset of { name, webhook_url, signing_secret, events, format, enabled, report_id }. Scope: `routines`.

post.description: Delivers a fake `revision.created` event through the real sign/format/deliver pipeline so you can verify the webhook wiring. 200 when the target accepted it, 502 when delivery failed. Scope: `routines`.

get.description: Raw AI-compute cost, the billable figure (raw × (1 + markup)), prepaid credit balance, and a per-skill breakdown for the current UTC month. Any valid token works (no specific scope). Also accepts a Supabase user-session JWT.

get.summary: Plan limits and AI-compute cost rails
get.description: The owner's plan, routine ceilings, per-run and monthly USD caps, markup, and month-to-date usage/headroom. Any valid token works (no specific scope). Also accepts a Supabase user-session JWT.

commaApiToken.description: Comma personal API token (Settings → API tokens). Scoped, revocable, optionally expiring. The same token also authenticates the MCP server at /api/mcp.

supabaseSessionJwt.description: Supabase user-session access token — the signed-in browser path. Only accepted where an operation explicitly lists it.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, or expired token.

Forbidden.description: Token missing the required scope, or no access to the resource.

NotFound.description: Resource not found (also returned instead of 403 where existence must not leak).

PayloadTooLarge.description: Payload exceeds a size limit (HTML > 5 MB; asset > 25 MB per file or > 250 MB per report).

UnprocessableEntity.description: Semantically invalid (e.g. plan ceiling exceeded, per-report asset count over 500).

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded. Rate limit: per-token sliding window (plan-aware — Free 60 req/min, Pro 600, Team/Enterprise 6000 by default); 429 responses carry a Retry-After header.

relative_path.description: POSIX-style path the HTML references, e.g. 'images/hero.png'. No leading slash, no '.'/'..' segments, no '%', '?' or '#'.

content_base64.description: Base64 file contents ('data:' URL prefix tolerated).

visibility.description: 'team' and 'domain' cannot be set at create time — use PUT /reports/{id}/share.

public_permission.description: Link permission for /p/:id. Forced to 'none' when visibility is 'private'.

producer_name.description: Attribution chip on the public view.

producer_url.description: http(s) only; anything else is dropped.

producer_icon_url.description: http(s) only; anything else is dropped.

source_recipe.description: Arbitrary JSON object powering the 'Continue this run' modal (.prompt, .tools).

assets.description: Inline assets; relative references in the HTML are rewritten to stored URLs.

html.description: Rendered HTML (falls back to the original upload).

ReportPatchRequest.description: At least one property must be present.

html.description: Non-empty, max 5 MB. Appends a revision (deduped when the content hash is unchanged).
Present on the top 3 results when include_html was set.

allowed_email_domains.description: Email domains allowed to view. Empty unless visibility is 'domain'.

embed_url.description: `/embed/{id}`, or null when embedding is off.

embed_snippet.description: Markup to paste into the host page, or null when embedding is off. Renders only while the report is public, its link permission isn't `none`, and it has no share password.

SharePutRequest.description: At least one property must be present.

allowed_email_domains.description: Required with, and only accepted with, visibility 'domain'. Bare domains (e.g. 'acme.com'); lowercased and de-duplicated. Replaces the existing list.

allowed_embed_origins.description: Bare origins (scheme + host + optional port, no path) allowed to iframe the report via `/embed/{id}`. https is required except for http://localhost and http://127.0.0.1. `[]` or `null` turns embedding off.

embed_url.description: `/embed/{id}`, or null when embedding is off.

embed_snippet.description: Markup to paste into the host page, or null when embedding is off. Renders only while the report is public, its link permission isn't `none`, and it has no share password.

replies_truncated.description: True when the thread has more than the 50 embedded replies.

nextCursor.description: Pass as ?cursor= to fetch the next page; null when exhausted.

block_id.description: Anchor to a block element id.

anchor_text.description: Exact text the comment anchors to.

relative_path.description: e.g. 'images/hero.png' — no leading slash, no '.'/'..' segments, no '%', '?' or '#'.

content_base64.description: Base64 bytes ('data:' URL prefix tolerated). Max 25 MB decoded.

report_id.description: null = applies to every report the owner has.

auto_on_revision.description: Run automatically whenever a new revision lands.

reviewer_url.description: http(s) endpoint that receives ReviewRequest payloads.

report_id.description: Pin to one report (requires edit access) or null for owner-wide.

reviewer_auth_header.description: Sent as the Authorization header to reviewer_url. Encrypted at rest; never returned.

ReviewerPatchRequest.description: At least one property must be present.

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON forwarded verbatim to trigger_url on each tick.

RoutineCreateRequest.description: At least one of trigger_url or skill_id is required.

trigger_url.description: Webhook mode: Comma POSTs here on each tick.

payload.description: JSON forwarded to trigger_url; max 8 KiB serialized.

skill_id.description: In-Comma run mode: the skill executes and appends a revision. Must be owned by you.

connector_ids.description: Connectors the skill may read through. Each must be owned by you.

RoutinePatchRequest.description: At least one property must be present.

trigger_url.description: null/'' clears it (when converting to skill mode).

workflow_id.description: Set when the run was dispatched to a background workflow (202).

source_ref.description: 'owner/repo[@sha-or-branch][:path/to/SKILL.md]' — public repos; resolved and pinned to a commit SHA.

name.description: Override the name parsed from SKILL.md frontmatter.

SkillPatchRequest.description: At least one property must be present.

Connector.description: Secret material is never included in any response.

kind.description: One of the catalog kinds, e.g. posthog, databricks, supabase, gdrive, stripe, slack.
Must be a catalog kind (see GET /connectors → definitions).

secret.description: Fields per the kind's secretSchema, e.g. { "token": "…" }. Encrypted at rest; never returned.

ConnectorPatchRequest.description: At least one property must be present. Providing `secret` rotates it.

report_id.description: null = every report the owner owns, was invited to, or shares with their team.
Scope to one report (must be viewable) or null for all.

signing_secret.description: Enables HMAC-signed deliveries. Encrypted at rest; never returned.

events.description: Defaults to all four event types.

NotificationPatchRequest.description: At least one property must be present.

http_status.description: Status returned by the webhook target.

month_start.description: First day of the current UTC month.

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Create, read, search, and update HTML reports.

tags.name: Revisions
tags.description: Revision history and line-level diffs. Every HTML update appends a revision; the share URL stays stable.

tags.name: Sharing
tags.description: Visibility and link permissions for the public share view (/p/:id).

tags.name: Comments
tags.description: Threaded, optionally text-anchored comments and replies.

tags.name: Assets
tags.description: Files attached to a report (images, stylesheets, data). Limits: 25 MB per file, 250 MB and 500 files per report.

tags.name: Reviews
tags.description: Claude Code review sessions and manual reviewer runs.

tags.name: Reviewers
tags.description: Standing AI reviewer agents that re-check a report when it changes and post findings as comments.

tags.name: Routines
tags.description: Scheduled regeneration: a routine fires a webhook or runs a skill on a cron and appends the output as a new revision.

tags.name: Skills
tags.description: Reusable prompts (inline, uploaded .zip bundle, or pinned GitHub SKILL.md) that routines execute.

tags.name: Connectors
tags.description: Encrypted third-party credentials (PostHog, Databricks, Supabase, Google Drive, Stripe, Slack) that skills can read data through.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: Webhook subscriptions on report events, deliverable as Slack, Discord, or plain JSON payloads.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Usage and plan limits for the token's owner.
